This market resolves according to reports from Reuters, The Associated Press (AP), The New York Times, The Washington Post, The Wall Street Journal, The Guardian, Politico, Semafor, The Information, CNN, Fox News, MSNBC, CNBC, or official statements from the White House, Department of State, Department of Defense, or the Government of Iran. Local newspapers and verifiable local mastheads in Tehran may be considered when named in the settlement source list. Photo: Reuters/Getty Images. Source: news outlets and social media.
